correctness.rationale: For every fixed |m| block, associated-Legendre parity makes same-parity half-interval inner products exactly delta_ell,k/2. The Sturm–Liouville Wronskian boundary term at x=0 is nonzero for every even/odd active degree pair and has denominator ell(ell+1)-k(k+1), so cross parity is a rectangular Cauchy matrix after invertible diagonal scalings; rank is min(e_m,o_m). The block spectrum is paired ±singular values around 1/2 with kernel dimension |e_m−o_m|; ±m degeneracy gives the global sum. Independently enumerated every contiguous band 0<=L0<=5, L1<=8, verifying w-even and odd formulas; analytic string parity argument proves all widths, not the enumeration.
